name_en: Etsu no nanban zuke — a fried river fish found only at one estuary, marinated sweet and sour
summary_ja: 筑後川河口域にしか生息しない幻の魚エツを唐揚げにし、南蛮酢に漬け込む。5月から7月の解禁期にしか漁ができない魚で、一般的なアジの南蛮漬けとは使う魚も漁の背景も異なるという。
summary_en: Etsu — a fish found nowhere but the Chikugo River estuary — is fried and steeped in a sweet-and-sour marinade. Caught only during a short open season from May to July, it sets this dish apart from the more common mackerel or horse-mackerel version of nanban-zuke.
source_title: エツの南蛮漬け 福岡県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
